text:
maria: Heads-up: Vendor (VeritasSec) requested a hybrid whitebox on staging + infra. Need to finalize RBAC handover, KMS access (AWS vs AZ KV), evidence ingest expectations, and retest windows. looping @dan @kevin @nisha
dan: Staging-only, ephemeral access only. Prefer OIDC SSO-derived roles with short-live sessions. Vendor asked if HSM-backed keys are required for decrypt during their tests.
kevin: We can offer two key options: 1) regular KMS key (AWS KMS, allow GenerateDataKey/Decrypt) or 2) HSM-backed (CloudHSM/CMK with ciphers restricted). If regulatory scope triggers HSM, we must provision an HSM-backed alias and note that vendor must support HSM encrypt/decrypt flows.
maria: Vendor also asked about Azure Key Vault possibility — they sometimes run tests from Azure infra. Can we support cross-cloud presign + KMS integration?
nisha: Audit notes: regardless of cloud, enable management + data events for the ingest prefix, tag logs with `pt_id`, forward to Splunk and Chronicle, retention 395 days. If vendor uses Azure, set Diagnostics settings to send storage logs to our SIEM and include correlation id.
kevin: Minimal AWS KMS policy snippet we can share (paste-only):
```
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-veritas-2026"}
```
kevin: If HSM is required we'll use a CMK with KeyUsage=ENCRYPT_DECRYPT and note that Decrypt operations are allowed only from sessions with the `pt-assessor` tag. We'll rotate the key after the engagement.
presign-bot: [INFO] Presign service constraints: max single-part PUT 300MB, require x-amz-meta-sha256, disallow multipart, require metadata field `pt_id`. Emit structured logs to /pt-presign.
dan: Upload pattern: vendor must POST to presign endpoint to get a URL, then PUT to `s3://pt-ingest/{pt_id}/incoming/{file}`. We require filename `pt-{id}/{type}/{file}` and checksum header. No anonymous uploads.
maria: Also request ObjectLock GOVERNANCE for 30d on locked objects and a post-upload checksum validator job that moves verified objects to `s3://pt-ingest/{pt_id}/locked/`.
kevin: For Azure uploads we can accept presigned SAS URLs for the Azure storage account with similar metadata requirements; we'll script a small translator service to normalize logs and checksums into our SIEM format. Note: Azure SAS expiry must be <= 1h.
audit-bot: [INFO] Logging schema requirement: {"svc":"presign","pt_id":"<id>","uploader":"vendor","file":"<name>","result":"success|fail","sha256":"<hex>"}. All logs must be JSON newline-delimited and forwarded to /pt-logs.
nisha: Intake options: preferred is webhook creating a `PT Intake` card on vuln-tracker. Backup: vendor may upload a signed CSV to the ingest prefix which we ingest nightly. SLA: ack within 24h, triage note within 48h, remediation plan for criticals within 3 business days.
maria: Retest policy: vendor can request one retest within 10 business days after we mark fixes deployed. We propose two candidate windows: 00:30-02:30 PT (overnight) or 09:00-11:00 PT. Oncall to confirm which is staffed.
oncall: [BOT] PagerDuty stub PD-PT-2026-VS created. I can cover the overnight slot if needed.
kevin: Action items (owner / due):
- kevin: create OIDC-based ephemeral role `pt-veritas-{id}`, craft session policy + KMS/KeyVault sample (due: EOD)
- nisha: enable CloudTrail (or Azure diag) data events for ingest prefix, configure SIEM forwarding and retention tags (due: EOD)
- dan: implement presign pipeline constraints + checksum validator + ObjectLock move (due: EOD)
- maria: send handshake email to vendor with S3/SAS examples, HSM note, and intake webhook URL (due: now)
maria: sample curl for upload (share with vendor):
```
# get presign (POST returns url)
curl -X POST "https://ingest.redwood.internal/presign" -d '{"pt_id":"VER123","file":"report.json"}' | jq -r .url
# upload
curl -H "x-amz-meta-sha256: <sha256>" -T report.json "<presigned-url>"
```
kevin: Note: post-window we'll rotate any keys used and revoke ephemeral sessions. If vendor requires HSM, we will provision but need 48h lead time.
nisha: Tiny compliance ask: if customer data might be included in findings, mask PII before we store results in vuln-tracker. Add automated scrub step to ingestion pipeline.
dan: acknowleged, will add scrub validator to checksum lambda.
oncall: ack
maria: sending handshake + runbook now -> https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-handshake-vs (includes HSM checklist + cross-cloud notes). Closing thread unless vendor asks for a different key model or longer retention. Thanks all!
